query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Audit and maintain Pipedrive CRM data: find deals and contacts, inspect activities/notes/pipeline stages, analyze sales-development activity hygiene, move long-horizon deals to a long-term review stage, create follow-up tasks for deals without future activity, and reassign mismatched deal owners.
query_ground_truth.query: inspect deal activities notes pipeline stages
query_ground_truth.intent: Retrieve and inspect associated activities, notes, and pipeline stages for given deals.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Pipedrive is a sales management tool built around pipeline visualization, lead tracking, activity reminders, and automation to keep deals progressing
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=pipedrive. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="pipedrive") to create a connection BEFORE executing any pipedrive tools.

PIPEDRIVE_PATCH_DEAL_FIELDS.description: Updates an existing deal custom field using PATCH method. Use when you need to modify field properties like name, visibility, or validation rules. Note that field code and type are immutable and cannot be changed.

field_code.description: The unique code identifying the field (40-character identifier for custom fields)

field_name.description: The name displayed for the field. At least one body parameter must be provided.

pipeline_ids.description: Specific pipeline IDs where the field is visible

ui_visibility.description: Settings controlling where the field appears in the web UI

enabled.description: Whether required fields feature is enabled

statuses.description: Pipeline ID to status array mapping (values: "won" or "lost")

stage_ids.description: Stage IDs where field is required

required_fields.description: Settings for marking as mandatory at certain stages

enabled.description: Whether important fields feature is enabled

stage_ids.description: Stage IDs where field is important

important_fields.description: Configuration for highlighting at specific stages

PIPEDRIVE_LIST_DEAL_ACTIVITIES.description: Lists activities associated with a deal.

done.description: Whether the activity is done or not. 0 = Not done, 1 = Done. If omitted, returns both Done and Not done activities.

exclude.description: A comma-separated string of activity IDs to exclude from result

PIPEDRIVE_CONVERT_LEAD_TO_DEAL.description: Tool to convert a Pipedrive lead to a deal asynchronously. Use when you need to convert an existing lead into a deal. The conversion transfers all related entities (notes, files, emails, activities) to the new deal. Upon successful conversion, the lead is marked as deleted. Use the returned conversion_id to check the conversion status.

id.description: The ID of the lead to convert (UUID format)

stage_id.description: The ID of a stage the created deal will be added to. The pipeline will be assigned automatically based on the stage_id. Do not use both pipeline_id and stage_id together.

pipeline_id.description: The ID of a pipeline the created deal will be added to. The deal will be added to the first stage of the specified pipeline. Note: pipeline_id will be ignored if both pipeline_id and stage_id are provided.

PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_DEAL_FIELDS.description: Returns data about all deal fields.

limit.description: Items shown per page. Must be > 0 if provided.
